intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. They share a group name, but the fees and placement years in our table are not identical. This page uses our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
CGC Jhanjeri vs CGC Landran for BBA is a two-campus comparison. Ignore the repeated short title and use the campus names when you read the numbers.

sections.heading: CGC Jhanjeri vs CGC Landran for BBA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CGC Landran if you want the slightly higher recorded BBA year fees, around ₹83,200 to ₹86,000, and you will ask for a placement report newer than the 2019 row we hold.
Choose CGC Jhanjeri if you want the recorded year figures of ₹80,200 for BBA General and BBA Service Industry, again after you get a post-2019 official placement note.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For CGC Jhanjeri we hold ₹80,200 as a Total Fees year figure for BBA Service Industry and ₹80,200 as tuition for BBA General. These are year amounts, not a confirmed three-year official total.
For CGC Landran we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹84,600 and ₹86,000 for BBA, and ₹83,200 for BBA (Service Industry). We have not added them into a programme total.
The recorded year fees are close. Confirm the current official notice on both campus sites before you budget for three years.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both placement rows are from 2019, so our summary table does not treat them as current flagship figures. CGC Jhanjeri's BBA Service Industry row shows a highest of ₹5 lakh, with no average recorded.
CGC Landran's BBA row shows a 2019 highest of ₹12 lakh, also with no average recorded. These are historical figures. Ask both cells for a 2024 or 2025 report if packages matter to you.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped for either BBA on this page. Follow the official undergraduate admissions notes for eligibility, dates and any institute test.
Both campuses list a general BBA and a service-industry option. Confirm which stream is open, and whether the fee differs, on the current prospectus.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are in Mohali, Punjab. The city is the same; the daily commute still depends on the exact campus and your accommodation.
Because they share a group name, a visit still helps. Check classrooms, internships support and hostel life on the campus you would join.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick CGC Landran if that campus and the slightly higher recorded year fee are fine, and you have a recent official BBA placement letter.
Pick CGC Jhanjeri if the ₹80,200 year figures and that campus fit your budget, again after you see a report newer than 2019.
Do not choose on the 2019 highest packages alone. They are too old to settle this comparison.

faqs.question: What BBA fees are on record for CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran?
faqs.answer: CGC Jhanjeri has year figures of ₹80,200. CGC Landran has year figures of ₹84,600 and ₹86,000 for BBA, and ₹83,200 for BBA (Service Industry). These are not confirmed three-year official totals.

faqs.question: Which campus has better BBA placements?
faqs.answer: We cannot say from current data. Both placement rows are from 2019: a ₹5 lakh highest at CGC Jhanjeri and a ₹12 lakh highest at CGC Landran, with no averages recorded. Ask for a later official report.

faqs.question: Are these two BBA campuses in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Mohali, Punjab, as separate campuses of the same wider group.

faqs.question: Is an entrance exam required?
faqs.answer: This page has no exam mapped for either BBA. Use the official admissions notices for eligibility and dates.

faqs.question: Do both campuses offer a service-industry BBA?
faqs.answer: Yes. CGC Jhanjeri lists BBA General and BBA Service Industry. CGC Landran lists BBA and BBA (Service Industry). Confirm seats on the current prospectus.

faqs.question: Should I treat the two campuses as identical?
faqs.answer: No. They share a group name but have different recorded year fees and separate campuses. Compare the campus you would actually attend.
